Die on purpose and ress up at the Ghost Healer
Buy: 1 Skinning Knife at Terunne Bearshaper
Die on purpose and ress up at the Ghost Healer
Kill all spiders whilst continuing the guide, we need 7 small Spider Legs later!
Set your to Teldrassil at Teldrassil (55.6, 59.8)
Die on purpose and ress up at the Ghost Healer
Die on purpose and ress up at the Ghost Healer

steps.tx: Set your to Stormwind City at Stormwind City (60.5, 75.2)
Get the flightpath at: Stormwind City (71.3, 72.3)
Stormwind City (69.1, 30.8) Take the Tram to Ironforge
Although the next guide is for levels 9-11 still do it,its mandatory.
I recommend getting a boar in Dun Morogh. Charge->Faster at the enemy->more Growl casts,less aggro on you.
Slowly fall to the ledge infront of you, and then to the ground.
Get the flightpath at: Loch Modan (33.9, 51)
Go South of Ameth 'Aran and kill as many Rabid Thistle Bears as possible, afterwards go to around (38, 60). You should find 6-10 to kill, that will do for now.
Fill the water tube at the nearby moonwell Darkshore (37.8, 44).
Get the flightpath at: Stormwind City (66.2, 62.4)
Start looking for a Halls of Thanes group.
CAREFUL, the endboss FEARS at roughly 35%, make sure to kill the adds first and move the boss into the previous room.
Use the lever right next to the Quest you just accepted, it opens the gates so you can run out in a straight line.
Start killing all Moonstalkers and Rabid Thistle Bears you see!
Fill the "Empty Cleansing Bowl" at the moonwell Darkshore (37.8, 44).
You can reach the following 5 sea creatures from WAY further away now than in classic. No classes should have any issues here anymore.
You come by WANTED MURKDEEP now. You can do it now or do it a little later(it will come up in the guide again). You have to get close to the bonfre to start the event.
Whilst going towards the next quest, kill all Moonstalker Sires you see. (Runts and Matriarchs are linked)
You got a phial from Onu, use it once you have entered the Masters Glaive and put it on the ground at Darkshore (39.2, 86.9).
ESCORT QUEST COMING,TURN OFF AUTO TURNIN/ACCEPT IF YOURE IN A GROUP!

There is a RARE quest drop - Book: The Powers Below - in the pit, I never got it regularly EVER(I only got it when the escort dryad wasnt there and I was grinding mobs till she spawns). Accept it if you got it.
"ESCORT QUEST COMING,TURN OFF AUTO TURNIN/ACCEPT IF YOURE IN A GROUP!

This quest was really hard in classic. In forever Blizzard has changed this to fit the ""modern audience""(#OnlyTwo btw) and made this a joke. Let Remtravel run ahead and only kill stuff after(he ignores anything that did not attack him first)."

Run to Darkshore (36.4, 75.6). Careful, there will be multiple waves with 2-3Murlocs each, kill the last murloc per wave away from the fire,eat/drink up and pull the next wave OR get a group! If you cant manage to do it,just skip it.
I suggest to do RoL now. RoL does not need any pre-quests you get all in the dungeon.
Get the flightpath at: Redridge Mountains (30.6, 59.4)
Look for a group for deadmines
The first 2 quests are in the cave but before the dungeon.
Do the dungeon now. The endboss drops a QuestItem. Accept it.
Either use Hearthstone now OR run out and turnin the quests: The Defias Brotherhood & Red Silk Bandanas. (If you dont turn them in now,youll turn them in at level 24)
Buy: 1 Bronze Tube at Billibub Cogspinner if it is in stock.
Kill as many Mongrels as you can at Redridge Mountains (10.8, 63.7)
Take the boat route to Auberdine.
ESCORT QUEST INCOMING,make sure all group members are on the same questprogress.
As a Group do Ruuzel, if youre solo skip it. (Some classes can do it solo too, Mage,Warlock,Hunter especially).
On your way through Duskwood kill spiders for some Gooey Spider legs.
If it is in stock - and you dont have one yet-: Buy a Bronzetube at Duskwood (78, 48.3)

The Look To The Stars questline can only be started if you have a bronzetube. If you did not get one yet that is fine, we will finish parts here now. At the end of this guide you will buy one from the ah. Next time you come to duskwood make sure to not forget this questline then.

There are two ghosts that drop a quest. They have spawns all over(need to be confirmed how many still) I will make them OPTIONAL accept quests now. the DO and TURNIN part is not in the guide yet, do them if you get them.
KEEP YOUR Gooey Spider Legs.Whilst grinding east for the spider and wolf quests do the next 2steps (TurnIn The Hermit and Accept Supplies from Darkshire)
Go upstairs and loot the Box.
Buy at the auction house now, if you did not get them yet: 1 Bronze tube. Gooey Spider Legs (you need 6 total) and 8 Murloc Fin.
If you do NOT have the stockade quests Crime And Punishment and What Comes Around... then do the next fly-steps. otherwise skip them.
We will turn in the other 2 dungeons quests in the next guide.
Search for people to do the Elite quests with.
Go upstairs and loot the Box
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore,Blackrock Bounty and Howling in the Hills are pretty hard quests solo. I usually skip them if I cant find a group I suggest just skipping all 3.
Go through the cave into Stonetalon Mountains.
Get the flightpath at: Stonetalon Mountains (36.45, 7.07)
Start looking for a BFD dungeon group.
Depending on what you do now the route differes:
You do BFD now: Go to the 26-27 BFD guide.
Continue questing: Fly to Auberdine and take the boat to Wetlands(Menethil Harbor)
Buy: 1 Flagon of Dwarven Honeymead at Innkeeper Helbrek
Kill Young Crocolisks from now on for their skin.

The next quest requires you to interact with a corpse downstairs. There are 1-3 elites that you might pull. Its easy: use your pet/frost nova/fear to get rid of the adds, interact with the corpse und run up the same way you came down. DO NOT attack the mobs and just run away.
Jump off the Bridge to go to Arathi Highlands (44.3, 92.9) and collect the Letter next to the dwarf
Get the flightpath at: Arathi Highlands (45.7, 46.1)
